description: Source code for the Mattermost server API related to job management, including endpoints for creating, retrieving, downloading, canceling, and updating jobs.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Main API struct for handling job-related endpoints.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Context object passed to handler functions, containing request-specific data and methods.

methods.name: InitJob
methods.description: Initializes the job-related API routes and handlers.

methods.name: getJob
methods.description: Retrieves a specific job by ID, with permission checks.

methods.name: downloadJob
methods.description: Handles downloading of job export files, supporting different job types and permission checks.

methods.name: createJob
methods.description: Creates a new job based on request payload, with permission validation.

methods.name: getJobs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of jobs filtered by type and status, with permission checks.

methods.name: getJobsByType
methods.description: Retrieves jobs of a specific type with permission validation.

methods.name: cancelJob
methods.description: Cancels a specified job, with permission validation and audit logging.

methods.name: updateJobStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific job, with permission and validity checks.
